title: IITH medical emergency
description: Blood for a transfusion is needed at the campus hospital during the lunch-hour delivery rush. Two emergency drones (from SNCC and the Main Gate) fly to the Hospital pad through peak delivery traffic. Watch the reserved emergency layer, the DTC giving them right of way, ADMM negotiations with delivery drones, and the emergency delay against the free-flow time.
timeline: Lunch-hour delivery wave: 120 drones depart within 90 s
@blood1 EMERGENCY SNCC → Hospital (2.3 km); priority 0 confirmed
@blood2 EMERGENCY Main Gate → Hospital, same landing pad
Reserved layer L2, DTC right of way, ADMM with delivery traffic
